description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams' used in the OrangeHRM system to encapsulate search filter parameters related to employee languages. It provides properties for employee number and language IDs, along with appropriate getters and setters, and defaults to sorting by language name.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams to specify filtering options for employee language search, including employee number and language IDs, with default sorting by language name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.

methods.name: getLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns the array of language IDs filter.

methods.name: setLanguageIds
methods.description: Sets the array of language IDs filter.
